components.name: Plate
components.description: A published photograph, edge to edge, captioned underneath.
components.css: .ds-plate { margin: 0; font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif; color: #1d211c; } .ds-plate-photo { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; background: #eff1ef; } .ds-plate figcaption { padding: 12px 20px 0; } .ds-plate strong { display: block; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-plate span { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.75; }

narrative.overview: 吱熊猫 is a book of named pandas, not a kit of cards. The page is olive paper. A hairline separates one fact from the next. When a screen is about one animal, that animal's photograph is the page: edge to edge, with the name and the distinguishing mark set underneath in the column, never on a scrim.
keyCharacteristics: One photograph, full width, captioned in the column.
Lists are hairline rows. A row is a name, then at most one muted line.
Four sizes only: 32, 20, 16, 12. Noto Sans SC.
Jade is rare, and the 科普 screens do not use it.
Dark mode is the same structure on the dark olive ground.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: The ground is olive-1 (`#fcfdfc` light, `#111210` dark). Do not introduce a second neutral, a gradient ground, or true black.

rules.name: The Accent Rule
rules.body: Jade does not fill a button, a card, or a progress bar. A primary action is ink on paper, reversed.

rules.name: The Four Size Rule
rules.body: If a hierarchy is weak, change weight, color, or space. Do not add a size.

rules.name: The Plate Rule
rules.body: The first figure on 科普 is one published photograph of a named panda. The caption sits under the picture. Text is not placed on the picture.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: A hairline or a change of type does the separating. A shadow and a border are not combined, and a resting row has neither a shadow nor a fill.

dos: Do use a published photograph of the panda the sentence is about.
Do keep draft 科普 out of the public catalog.
Do reveal quiz names only after the answer, and do not repeat the choice photo as the question.
donts: Don't put an icon in a tinted square.
Don't use a gradient hero, a scrim, or glass.
Don't use the same rounded card for every fact.
Don't put a kicker above the title.
Don't introduce a color, a type size, or a shadow the rest of the atlas does not already use.
